references.text: The verse continues the description of the remaining land and mentions the five Philistine rulers, which complements the reference to the Philistine territories.
It also mentions the Philistines and Geshurites as peoples who remained in the land to test Israel.
It refers to the Geshurites as a people who lived in the land from ancient times, confirming their presence in the unconquered territory.
It notes that Anakim remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod—Philistine cities—showing that Philistine land was not fully conquered.
God's promise regarding the borders of the land included the Sea of the Philistines, indicating that Philistine territory was part of the promised land.
The prophet Joel mentions the Philistine territories in connection with God's judgment, confirming their historical significance as Israel's neighboring people.
